subject: Data Engineering
title: Monitoring Warehouse Health
description: A fast breakdown of Monitoring Warehouse Health for builders.

hook.text: Users complain the dashboard is slow. Is it the query, the data pipeline, or the warehouse itself?

buildup.text: Warehouse health metrics include query queue time, spill to disk, scan efficiency, and credit usage.

discovery.text: Long queue times mean not enough compute. Spill to disk means queries need more memory.

twist.text: Monitoring dashboards consume warehouse resources too. A badly built monitor can be the cause of slowness.

climax.text: Proactive monitoring catches performance issues before users notice — and before costs spiral.

punchline.text: Healthy warehouse, happy analysts. Monitor early.

quiz.question: What does long queue time in a warehouse indicate?
options: Not enough compute resources are available
The warehouse is being backed up
